component.name: OpenROM
component.summary: Universal Retro Gaming Toolkit — convert, patch, compress and manage ROMs

description.p: OpenROM is a free, open-source Universal Retro Gaming Toolkit. One app to replace every fragmented ROM tool — convert, patch, compress, clean headers, and manage your collection, all running 100% offline with no telemetry.

ul.li: 20+ conversion paths: ISO, CHD, CSO, ZSO, ECM, BIN/CUE, GDI, XISO, RVZ, WIA, WBFS, GCZ
Smart magic byte platform detection — PS1, PS2, PSP, Xbox, GameCube, Wii, Dreamcast, Saturn, Sega CD
Real CHD v4/v5 header parsing — accurate CD vs DVD detection
Auto CUE sheet generation for standalone BIN files
9 patch formats: IPS, IPS32, UPS, BPS, PPF, APS, EBP, DPS, xdelta3
Auto patch format detection and CRC32 checksum verification
ZIP and 7Z compression with fast/normal/ultra presets
ROM header removal for NES, SNES, Game Boy, and GBC
M3U playlist generator for multi-disc games
Gaming dashboard UI with drag and drop queue and real-time progress
4 built-in themes plus custom JSON theme support
Full headless CLI for scripting and automation
Bundled tools — no extra installs needed
No telemetry, no network requests, runs 100% locally

description.p: Hardened and rewrote the .orplug plugin subsystem with signature and manifest validation. Fixed xdelta3 resolution on Windows and made the application version fully dynamic. Split Linux releases into standalone AppImages and separate core-only CLI archives.
Added Sega Saturn, Sega CD, PC-Engine CD, and Neo Geo CD platform detection. Expanded ROM toolkit scope with patching, compression, header removal, and M3U generation fully documented.

Migrated openrom-core build from PyInstaller to Nuitka. AV false positive rate reduced from 27/67 to 14/67. Fixed ISO to CHD command selection for PS1 and Dreamcast. Added full Xbox ISO detection at offset 0x2090000.
Added ROM patcher with 9 patch formats, ZIP/7Z compression, ROM header removal, M3U playlist generator, BIN merger, and theme system.
Added RVZ/WIA/WBFS/GCZ support via nodtool, PSP ISO detection, and Convert button fix.
Added CLI interface, per-job progress bar, CHD info panel, and bug fixes.
